method.registry_probe: Single bounded GET https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=<token>&limit=100 per token, 15s timeout, first page only, sequential, no background loops, curl -s -m 15 inline inside bounded shell loops (3 calls, resuming from already-fetched tokens each time the 2-minute tool timeout hit mid-loop). count = servers.length on page 1. our_rank = [1-based index, name] for every row on that page whose name matches /theluckystrike/i.
method.token_set: The 97-token NAMING_R4 set (comparable with INTEL_R8's 51.26% measurement, itself over a 100-token set that included 3 tokens outside the 97) plus 16 net-new tokens targeted by names published since R8: qr-code, letterhead, label, appointment, credit-note, purchase-order, deposit, per-diem, travel-allowance, delegacja, depreciation, fixed-assets, aging, dunning, statement-of-account, archive (retainer was already inside the 97-token set) -- 113 distinct tokens probed live on 2026-09-06.
method.findable_share_formula: NAMING_R4 formula, unchanged: p = min(1, 10/our_rank) if our current-version row appears on page 1 for that token, else 0; mean over the token set (computed separately for the 97-token set and the 113-token extended set).

set_97.note: INTEL_R8's 51.26% was measured over a 100-token set (the 97-token set plus zip/archive/qr-code, compress already inside the 97); this round's 97-token number is the direct like-for-like continuation. Small regression, not a data quality issue: page-1 slots on shared tokens shifted as more theluckystrike rows (billing-docs, asset-register, per-diem, statement-of-account, and new variants on existing servers) now compete against each other for the same tracked tokens, and one or two previously-page-1 ranks slipped past rank 10 as the registry's own catalog grew.

set_extended_113.note: 97-token set plus the 16 tokens targeted by names published for the newest servers (billing-docs, asset-register, per-diem, statement-of-account) and by new variants on barcode (qr-code, label) and docx (letterhead). Not comparable to earlier rounds' percentages since the denominator differs; reported separately as instructed.

part1_registry_findable_share.kpi_row_after: Registry findable share: value 50, target 60, unit % of tracked tokens (data/kpi.json, from node scripts/kpi.mjs, sourced from data/organic.json's 97-token-comparable figure)
